notes: Primary source: Epson official Specification Sheet (CPD-54435, epson.com/largevenue) and Epson product page, cross-checked against Epson's internal EB-L1755U/EB-L1750U service spec PDF (same optical/electronic engine, US-market Pro L1755UNL is the no-lens SKU of the EB-L1755U) and ProjectorReviews.com hardware teardown photos. The '5-BNC' interface is listed by Epson simply as '5-BNC' with no RGBHV grade given, and BNC/SDI ports carry no HDMI/DP-style version numbers so no grade was set beyond the 3G-SDI input (explicitly named in spec, so sdi-3g). HDMI grade of 2.0 is inferred (medium-confidence detail) from HDCP 2.2 support and documented 4K/UHD signal acceptance via the HDMI/HDBaseT input combined with a 60Hz vertical scan ceiling — Epson's spec sheet does not explicitly print an 'HDMI 2.0' version string, so treat this single grade as inferred rather than confirmed. The dedicated LAN RJ45 network port (100BASE-TX/10BASE-T, distinct from the HDBaseT RJ45) is documented in Epson's EB-L1755U series internal spec sheet and confirmed visually in third-party teardown photos, but is omitted from the consumer-facing spec sheet's 'Interfaces' list — treat as medium confidence. Unit is a desktop/mount-style large-venue installation projector, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. This is the 'without lens' (NL) SKU — nine optional lenses sold separately; connector list is identical to the lensed EB-L1755U model.

ports.name: HDBaseT
ports.note: Combined video/audio/control over CAT cable via HDBaseT; also used for Art-Net control per manufacturer footnote.

ports.name: 5-BNC (RGBHV)
ports.note: Analog component/RGB video input, five BNC connectors ganged as one interface.

ports.name: Monitor Out
ports.note: Mini D-sub 15-pin analog monitor loop-through output.

ports.name: USB-B (Service)
ports.note: Service/firmware use only, not a general host port.

ports.name: USB-A (Wireless LAN)
ports.note: For optional ELPAP10 wireless LAN module only.

ports.name: LAN (RJ45)
ports.note: 100BASE-TX/10BASE-T network port per Epson's EB-L1755U service spec sheet (same engine as Pro L1755UNL).

ports.name: Remote (Wired)
ports.note: 3.5mm mini-jack port for hardwired remote control accessory.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: 100-240V AC universal power inlet; detachable IEC power cable included in box.
